scope: Deterministic ELF/frame sizes, not timing, RSS or cache measurements.

cases.name: guarded_total
cases.source:
@verbose 0.1.0

concept LineItem
  @intention: "Bound quantity and integer unit price before calculating a total"
  @source: guarded_total.intent:1
  fields:
    quantity : number [0, 1000]
    unit_price : number [0, 1000000]

rule total
  @intention: "Calculate the zero and positive quantity cases with explicit guards"
  @source: guarded_total.intent:2
  input:
    item : LineItem
  output:
    out : number
  logic:
    out = if item.quantity == 0 then item.quantity * item.unit_price else if item.quantity > 0 then item.quantity * item.unit_price else 0
  proofs:
    purity:
      reads : [item.quantity, item.unit_price]
      calls : []
    termination:
      bound : 20
  hints:
    overflow : [0, 1000000000]
cases.intent:
Quantity is an integer in [0, 1000] and unit price is an integer in [0, 1000000].
Multiply quantity by unit price in the zero and positive cases, with a final zero fallback; the compiler must verify every branch before simplifying redundant guards.

cases.name: deep_dead_arm
cases.source:
@verbose 0.1.0
concept Input
  @intention: "Bound a numeric code-size fixture"
  @source: deep.intent:1
  fields:
    x : number [-10, 10]
    y : number [1, 5]
rule checked
  @intention: "Check an impossible arm before removing its arithmetic"
  @source: deep.intent:1
  input:
    i : Input
  output:
    out : number
  logic:
    out = if i.x > 0 then if i.x <= 0 then i.y + (i.y + (i.y + (i.y + (i.y + (i.y + (i.y + (i.y + (i.y + (i.y + (i.y + (i.y + (i.y + (i.y + (i.y + (i.y + (i.y + (i.y + (i.y + (i.y + (i.y + (i.y + (i.y + (i.y + (i.y + (i.y + (i.y + (i.y + (i.y + (i.y + (i.y)))))))))))))))))))))))))))))) else i.x else 0
  proofs:
    purity:
      reads : [i.x, i.y]
      calls : []
    termination:
      bound : 1000
  hints:
    overflow : [-1000, 1000]
cases.intent: A bounded synthetic case for checking code and frame size.

cases.name: existing_increment
cases.source:
@verbose 0.1.0

concept Reading
  @intention: "A signed reading with the full i64 input domain"
  @source: guarded_numeric.intent:1
  fields:
    value : number

rule ratio
  @intention: "Use explicit sign guards and a zero fallback for signed division"
  @source: guarded_numeric.intent:2
  input:
    reading : Reading
  output:
    out : number
  logic:
    let divisor = reading.value
    out = if divisor > 0 then 100 / divisor else if divisor < 0 then 100 / divisor else 0
  proofs:
    purity:
      reads : [reading.value]
      calls : []
    termination:
      bound : 20
  hints:
    overflow : [-100, 100]

rule increment
  @intention: "An explicit condition prevents incrementing beyond i64::MAX"
  @source: guarded_numeric.intent:3
  input:
    reading : Reading
  output:
    out : number
  logic:
    out = if reading.value < 9223372036854775807 then reading.value + 1 else reading.value
  proofs:
    purity:
      reads : [reading.value]
      calls : []
    termination:
      bound : 10
  hints:
    overflow : [-9223372036854775807, 9223372036854775807]
cases.intent:
A signed reading may occupy the full i64 domain.
Divide 100 by a nonzero reading, using signed truncation toward zero; return zero for a zero reading.
Increment a reading unless it is already i64::MAX, in which case retain that maximum.

validation: Both compilers agree with integer oracles and candidate interpreter on all valid cases; invalid and partial records retain stdout/stderr/status; allocation syscall traces are empty; four unsupported-backend refusals preserve artifacts. The changed existing increment and its neighboring ratio entry each pass 205 oracle/reference/candidate/interpreter cases and eight entry-compatibility cases.
